$comment: SOURCE, NOT GENERATED. Every icon renamed after it shipped: the old name, the new one, and the version the new name ships in. next.config.ts redirects each old icon page to its new one. A rename from 1.0.0 on is also an alias, because a 1.x name is a promise to everyone who imported it: pipeline/build-react.mjs keeps the old export as a deprecated alias of the new component, pipeline/build-data.mjs ships the list so the CLI and MCP resolve the old name, next.config.ts forwards the old registry items, and pipeline/build-history.mjs files the drawing's history under its new name, so the rename is not announced as a new drawing or badged New. Earlier renames were breaking changes by the rules of 0.x and stay that way. The aliases go at the next major. The old name also belongs under the new one in the `names` map of lib/icon-aliases.json, which is what search reads.
